## Checklist

- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes and `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- [ ] REFERENCE.md covers changes to config fields, defaults, constructors, wire formats or errors.
- [ ] AGENTS.md "Known gaps" drops a fixed gap or lists a new one.
- [ ] forgo has a matching pull request if a forgo contract changed.
